#### Reading in data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(rsample)

# Read from URL
bike_url <- "https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~online/datasets/SeoulBikeData.csv"
raw_data <- read_csv(bike_url, locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"))
```

#### Exploratory Analysis and Prep

```{r}
#Check missingness and structure
sum(is.na(raw_data))
glimpse(raw_data)

#Clean names, convert date format, convert factors
bike_clean <- raw_data |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>

  mutate(
    # Forma dataset dd/mm/yyyy
    date = dmy(date),
    seasons = as.factor(seasons),
    holiday = as.factor(holiday),
    functioning_day = as.factor(functioning_day)
  )

#Initial summaries =
bike_clean |>
  group_by(functioning_day) |>
  summarize(
    total_rentals = sum(rented_bike_count),
    mean_rentals = mean(rented_bike_count),
    n = n()
  )

# Filter to keep functional hours only:
bike_functional <- bike_clean |>
  filter(functioning_day == "Yes")

# 1 observation per day
# Sum for bike count, rainfall, snowfall, Mean for all other numeric weather variables
daily_bike <- bike_functional |>
  group_by(date, seasons, holiday) |>
  summarize(
    rented_bike_count = sum(rented_bike_count),
    rainfall = sum(rainfall_mm),
    snowfall = sum(snowfall_cm),
    temperature = mean(temperature_c),
    humidity = mean(humidity_percent),
    wind_speed = mean(wind_speed_m_s),
    visibility = mean(visibility_10m),
    dew_point_temperature = mean(dew_point_temperature_c),
    solar_radiation = mean(solar_radiation_mj_m2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Summaries
summary(daily_bike)

# Correlation matrix 
numeric_cols <- daily_bike |> select(where(is.numeric))
cor(numeric_cols)

# Exploratory plot: Rentals vs Temperature colored by Season
ggplot(daily_bike, aes(x = temperature, y = rented_bike_count, color = seasons)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Bike Rentals vs. Temperature by Season",
    x = "Mean Daily Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Total Daily Rentals"
  )
```

#### Splitting the data in to 75/25 split train test

```{r}
set.seed(123) # Set  seed

bike_split <- initial_split(daily_bike, prop = 0.75, strata = seasons)
train_data <- training(bike_split)
test_data  <- testing(bike_split)
```

#### 

#### Features

```{r}
# Create day factort (1-7)
add_day_type <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(
      day_type = if_else(wday(date) %in% c(1, 7), "Weekend", "Weekday"),
      day_type = as.factor(day_type)
    )
}

train_data <- add_day_type(train_data)
test_data  <- add_day_type(test_data)

# Numeric predictors 
num_vars <- c("temperature", "humidity", "wind_speed", "visibility", 
              "dew_point_temperature", "solar_radiation", "rainfall", "snowfall")

# Compute training means and std dev
train_means <- sapply(train_data[num_vars], mean)
train_sds   <- sapply(train_data[num_vars], sd)

# Standardize
standardize_vars <- function(df, means, sds, vars) {
  for (v in vars) {
    df[[v]] <- (df[[v]] - means[v]) / sds[v]
  }
  df
}

train_std <- standardize_vars(train_data, train_means, train_sds, num_vars)
test_std  <- standardize_vars(test_data, train_means, train_sds, num_vars)

train_sds
train_means


```

#### Fitting 3 models and evaluating performance

```{r}
# Model 1 - standardized numeric predictors + categorical variables
m1 <- lm(
  rented_bike_count ~ temperature + humidity + wind_speed + visibility + 
    dew_point_temperature + solar_radiation + rainfall + snowfall + 
    seasons + holiday + day_type,
  data = train_std
)

# Model 2 = Model 1 + specific interaction terms
m2 <- lm(
  rented_bike_count ~ temperature + humidity + wind_speed + visibility + 
    dew_point_temperature + solar_radiation + rainfall + snowfall + 
    seasons + holiday + day_type + 
    seasons:holiday + seasons:temperature + temperature:rainfall,
  data = train_std
)

# Model 3: Model 2 + quadratic terms for temp and humidity
m3 <- lm(
  rented_bike_count ~ temperature + humidity + wind_speed + visibility + 
    dew_point_temperature + solar_radiation + rainfall + snowfall + 
    seasons + holiday + day_type + 
    seasons:holiday + seasons:temperature + temperature:rainfall + 
    I(temperature^2) + I(humidity^2),
  data = train_std
)

# Helper function for test set RMSE
calc_rmse <- function(model, new_data) {
  preds <- predict(model, newdata = new_data)
  sqrt(mean((new_data$rented_bike_count - preds)^2))
}

#printing results as a tibble for easy view
rmse_results <- tibble(
  Model = c("Model 1 (Main Effects)", 
            "Model 2 (+ Interactions)", 
            "Model 3 (+ Quadratic Terms)"),
  Test_RMSE = c(calc_rmse(m1, test_std),
                calc_rmse(m2, test_std),
                calc_rmse(m3, test_std))
)

rmse_results
```

#### Fitting thebest model (lowest rmse) - model 3

```{r}
# Standardize full dataset
full_data <- add_day_type(daily_bike)

full_means <- sapply(full_data[num_vars], mean)
full_sds   <- sapply(full_data[num_vars], sd)

full_std <- standardize_vars(full_data, full_means, full_sds, num_vars)

# Model 3
final_model <- lm(
  rented_bike_count ~ temperature + humidity + wind_speed + visibility + 
    dew_point_temperature + solar_radiation + rainfall + snowfall + 
    seasons + holiday + day_type + 
    seasons:holiday + seasons:temperature + temperature:rainfall + 
    I(temperature^2) + I(humidity^2),
  data = full_std
)

# Report final coefficients
summary(final_model)$coefficients
```
